profile: SQLite 3.47.2 with default expression name resolution and normal ALTER TABLE rename semantics.
scope: A native implicit CHECK label from one unqualified declared column, a comparison symbol and a nonnegative decimal integer.

Schema/Predicate/ImplicitCheckLabel.role: The presentation of a failure label derived from an unnamed comparison.
Schema/Predicate/ImplicitCheckLabel.structure: An identifier spelling and quote mode, a comparison glyph, whitespace around the glyph and the decimal zero prefix count.
Schema/Predicate/ImplicitCheckLabel.conditions: The owning CHECK matches the token with the resolved comparison of one local column and a nonnegative signed-range decimal. The owning table matches the spelling to the referenced slot. The layout stores only checked name, spacing and numeric presentation values.
Schema/Predicate/ImplicitCheckLabel.meaning: Bare identifiers display the checked comparison spelling. Quoted leading identifiers display the decoded name. Later native column rename updates the implicit label through the comparison tokens.
Schema/Predicate/ImplicitCheckLabel.externalInterpretation: Use the resolved declared column and the same SQLite native schema rewrite.
Schema/Predicate/ImplicitCheckLabel.sql: Emit an unnamed CHECK with the resolved operands and their checked diagnostic presentation.

Schema/Predicate/ComparisonSpelling.role: One native comparison glyph and its resolved operation.
Schema/Predicate/ComparisonSpelling.structure: Exactly eight glyphs for equality, inequality and ordered comparisons.
Schema/Predicate/ComparisonSpelling.conditions: The comparison token must name the same operation as the checked condition.
Schema/Predicate/ComparisonSpelling.meaning: Equality and inequality aliases have the same operation and retain distinct diagnostic spellings.
Schema/Predicate/ComparisonSpelling.externalInterpretation: Use native SQLite comparison semantics for the recorded operation.

observations: Compare the exact native constraint label, success and persisted rows for different typed inputs, including NULL.
Compare original, bare-renamed and quoted-renamed table effects. An independent fixture distinguishes the referenced and owning slots.
Probe all 147 native keywords for the bare identifier role. For analyzed cases compare both original and rendered SQL.

finite.identity: Exhaust all owner, spelling, glyph, layout and literal combinations for 192 distinct constructors. Each one observes original, bare rename and quoted rename effects.

exploration.structure: Vary column names, owners and referenced slots, glyphs, quote modes, whitespace, integer width and native rename effects. Include empty and UTF-8 quoted names and the signed endpoint.

negative: A bare spelling does not denote a checked column
The label names another declared column than the resolved operand
The right operand is negative or has another scalar role
An analyzed first or last token has comment text outside the admitted presentation
faults: Replace a comparison alias with the canonical symbol
Use an explicit label that persists after rename
predecessorCheck: Retain newly admitted original unnamed CHECK cases as analyzed positives. Keep the previous rejection checks and budgets using an unnamed CHECK with unresolved comment layout.
open: Implicit labels for other expressions, keyword operators, qualification, comments, unary signs and presentation outside the stated envelope.
trust: SQLite CHECK parsing, dequoting and native rename rules
Independent label, comparison and rename observations
Exact PHP value closure and binding checks
